relations.evidence: chrīharṣacandro ... vaidyavasuvarmaṇaḥ pustakam idaṃ paṭhitvārtham avagamya sarvaṃm satvānām upadeśaṃ vidhātuṃ pratipāditam

date.as_written: varśe caikottare smiṃs tritayaśatagate mādhave māsi śukle saptamyāṃ puṣya ṛkṣe da[..]śatakiraṇāvāsare siddhayoge

purpose: paṭhitvārtham avagamya sarvaṃm satvānām upadeśaṃ vidhātuṃ
notes: The era year 301 is dated by scholars to the post-Licchavi Mānadeva Saṃvat, corresponding to 878 CE. The manuscript contains folios from multiple manuscripts; the extracted colophon belongs to the Suśrutasaṃhitā on folio 209 (Devanagari 109).
